:::{#exm-bernoulli-pmf}
#### The first of two coin flips

In @exm-random-variable,
let $X_1$ indicate heads on the first flip,
so

$$
\begin{aligned}
X_1(HH) &= X_1(HT) \\
&= 1
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
X_1(TH) &= X_1(TT) \\
&= 0.
\end{aligned}
$$

Then

$$
\begin{aligned}
\P(X_1 = 1) &= \Pr(\set{HH, HT}) \\
&= 1/2
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
\P(X_1 = 0) &= \Pr(\set{TH, TT}) \\
&= 1/2,
\end{aligned}
$$

so $X_1 \sim \Ber(1/2)$.

:::
